interface_name.description: Name of the network interface to listen on (e.g., 'eth0', 'wg0', or 'all' for all interfaces).

interface_type.description: Interface type for the main interface. Usually 'unicast' or 'multicast'.

pool_prefix.description: IPv6 prefix for the primary address pool (e.g., '2001:db8:1::').

pool_prefix_length.description: Prefix length for the primary pool (e.g., 64).

pool_delegation_length.description: Prefix delegation length for PD (Prefix Delegation); typically same as prefix length for L3 subnets.

address_pools.description: Additional IPv6 address pools to allocate from.

leases_file.description: Path to the file where assigned leases are persisted.

class_definitions.description: Client class definitions to match and categorize clients.

server_id.description: Unique server identifier (DUID-LLT format recommended). Can be auto-generated if omitted, but static is recommended for production.

dns_servers.description: List of IPv6 DNS server addresses for clients (e.g., ['2001:4860:4860::8888', '2001:4860:4860::8844']).

domain_search.description: Domain search list to provide to clients (e.g., ['example.com', 'internal.net']).

ntp_servers.description: List of NTP server IPv6 addresses for time synchronization.

relay_upstream.description: Upstream relay servers to forward client packets to (for relay-mode operation).

max_lease_time.description: Maximum lease duration in seconds (e.g., 86400 = 1 day).

min_lease_time.description: Minimum allowed lease duration in seconds (e.g., 600 = 10 minutes).

default_lease_time.description: Default lease duration in seconds (e.g., 7200 = 2 hours).

interface_bindings.description: Bind specific client classes to specific interfaces (e.g., for multi-homed servers).

static_mappings.description: Static IPv6 address assignments by client identifier (MAC address).

address.description: IPv6 address to assign (must be inside a configured pool prefix).

multicast_relay.description: Enable relay of multicast DHCPv6 messages (for large-scale deployments).

rapid_commit.description: Enable rapid commit (2-packet exchange) for faster address assignment.
